jobs.title: Application engineer Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


✔ Werken aan industriële automatisering bij toonaangevende klanten in Food, Chemie en Pharma. ✔ Ontwerpen, programmeren en optimaliseren van PLC\-, DCS\-, SCADA\- en MES\-oplossingen. ✔ Fulltime rol met leaseauto, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en zichtbaar resultaat in de fabriekshal.
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Als Application engineer Industrial Automation ga je procesbesturingssystemen ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren voor productieomgevingen in de Food \& Beverage, Oil \& Gas, Pharma en Chemie. Je werkt projectmatig voor klanten in de BENELUX, soms op locatie bij de installatie, soms vanuit het kantoor in Zeist. Jij vertaalt proceswensen naar betrouwbare automatiseringsoplossingen en ondersteunt opdrachtgevers technisch bij het gebruik en verbeteren van hun systemen. Daarbij speel je een zichtbare rol in het aansluiten van software, proceslogica en praktijk, zodat installaties correct draaien en data betrouwbaar beschikbaar is. Vanuit die rol ontwikkel je je stap voor stap tot specialist in industriële automatisering en procesoptimalisatie, met nadruk op het programmeren én het slimmer maken van automatiseringsprocessen. In de kern draait jouw werk om het realiseren, testen en verbeteren van industriële automatiseringsoplossingen voor veeleisende productieomgevingen:

  

* Programmeren van PLC\-, DCS\-, SCADA\- en MES\-applicaties voor procesbesturing.
* Opstellen van functionele specificaties op basis van klanteisen en procesdata.
* Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van besturingslogica samen met de opdrachtgever.
* Simuleren, testen en valideren van applicaties inclusief ondersteuning bij inbedrijfname.
* Geven van technische trainingen aan gebruikers en beheerders van de nieuwe software.

  

Je werkt mee aan projecten bij toonaangevende industriële klanten, variërend van optimalisatie van verpakkingslijnen tot automatisering van tankopslag en digitalisering van productieprocessen in de chemie en farma, waardoor je continu met actuele technieken en vraagstukken in industriële automatisering bezig bent.


### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**


In deze rol werk je gestructureerd, neem je eigenaarschap over je deel van het project en schakel je zorgvuldig met opdrachtgevers en collega’s. Je hebt een praktische houding, duikt graag de techniek in en blijft rustig analyseren als processen complex zijn of snel wijzigen.

  

* Afgeronde wo\-opleiding of bachelor in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, procestechnologie, informatica of vergelijkbaar, eventueel aangevuld met een master in Systems \& Control of Control \& Operations.
* Bereidheid om op projectbasis te werken bij klanten binnen de BENELUX, gecombineerd met inzet op inhouse\-projecten in Zeist.
* Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift voor documentatie en klantcontact.
* Ervaring of aantoonbare kennis van industriële automatisering met PLC, DCS, SCADA en MES, bijvoorbeeld via studieprojecten, stage of eerste baan.
* Sterk analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken, gecombineerd met leergierigheid om nieuwe systemen en technieken zoals C\# en slimme scripts grondig te doorgronden.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**


Als fulltime Application engineer Industrial Automation werk je aan projecten met directe impact op industriële processen.

  

* Een salaris tussen €3\.200,\- en €4\.800,\- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring in industriële automatisering.
* 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV\-dagen per jaar, passend bij een fulltime dienstverband.
* Leaseauto met tank\- of laadpas voor reizen naar klanten in de BENELUX.
* Een boeiend en afwisselend takenpakket met grote zelfstandigheid en direct zichtbare resultaten van je werk in industriële omgevingen.
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Bijdrage van 68% aan het pensioen.
* Eerst een jaarcontract, daarna uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  

Daarnaast zijn er nog meer arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, die we graag in een persoonlijk gesprek verder toelichten. Samen verder praten over deze functie als Application engineer Industrial Automation. Reageer vandaag en krijg binnen 1 werkdag een terugkoppeling. Neem direct contact op met Nick Jansen via 06 \- 25 48 11 44\.


### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Je gaat aan de slag bij een gespecialiseerde industriële automatiseringspartij die procesbesturingen ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en implementeert voor productieomgevingen in onder andere de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, olie\- en gassector, chemie en farmacie. Vanuit het kantoor in Zeist worden zowel inhouse\-projecten gerealiseerd als opdrachten bij klanten in de BENELUX uitgevoerd. De organisatie richt zich op het automatiseren en optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen met slimme componenten en software, waarbij technieken als PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES en C\# worden ingezet voor moderne procesbesturingssystemen en digitalisering van productie.

  

Je werkt in een team met collega’s die een duidelijke passie voor techniek hebben en graag samen projecten realiseren. De sfeer is informeel en hands\-on, met korte lijnen en veel directe samenwerking tussen engineers en andere collega’s. In de praktijk betekent dit dat je regelmatig op locatie bij toonaangevende bedrijven staat om systemen te testen of in bedrijf te nemen, en op kantoor in Zeist samenwerkt aan ontwerp, ontwikkeling en simulatie. Er is veel aandacht voor kennisdeling, professionele ontwikkeling en het combineren van inhoudelijk uitdagend werk met een prettige werkomgeving, inclusief gezamenlijke activiteiten en uitjes.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer hybrid job in Breda area
jobs.description:
**AI Software Engineer**


Breda, Netherlands (hybrid) · Senior, 7\+ years · Legal \& professional services


Epona365 is a cloud\-native platform built on Microsoft 365, used by legal and professional services firms across Europe. It integrates deeply with SharePoint, Exchange, Teams and Office, and runs asynchronous workers for OCR and metadata prediction, and semantic search.


We are looking for a senior engineer with strong AI knowledge. You will work across the full stack \- .NET services, Office add\-ins for Excel and Outlook, the web UI and Azure infrastructure \- with AI features as your focus. We use AI coding agents throughout the development cycle, from analyzing stories to writing code and resolving review comments: developers here direct outcomes rather than type code.


**What you will work on**


* Azure AI features \- filing and metadata suggestions, semantic search over firm documents, agentic workflows on Azure AI Agents.
* .NET microservices \- APIs, workers and processing pipelines.
* Office add\-ins and web UI \- TypeScript and the Office JavaScript API.
* Microsoft 365 integrations \- Graph SDK, SharePoint CSOM, Exchange Web Services.
* Azure infrastructure \- Container Apps, Bicep, Azure Pipelines, Docker.

You also help decide what we build: brainstorming new AI use cases with sales and consultants, prototyping quickly, and being honest about what is feasible today and what is not.


**Must haves**


* 7\+ years of professional development experience.
* Deep C\# and .NET \- services, APIs and asynchronous workers \- plus solid TypeScript.
* Experience shipping AI features in production: features real users depend on, not research or notebooks.
* Hands\-on with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry: prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling.
* Retrieval\-augmented generation: chunking and embedding documents, vector search, and grounding answers so they stay traceable to a source.
* Judgement about when not to use a language model, and awareness of cost, latency and prompt injection.
* Comfortable with AI coding agents: you can specify, review and correct machine\-written code.
* Able to explain to non\-technical colleagues, in plain language, what a model can and cannot do.

**Nice to haves**


* Semantic Kernel or Microsoft.Extensions.AI, and the Azure AI Agent Service.
* Azure AI Search (vector and hybrid) and Azure AI Document Intelligence.
* Model Context Protocol, or Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility.
* SharePoint development, or front\-end single\-page application experience.
* Legal tech, document management or another regulated sector.

You are analytical and proactive, communicate clearly, and enjoy working in an international, multidisciplinary team.

You must have experience in programming languages and frameworks of C\# and React and have some experience of working with AWS and Azure. Experience of GIT for source code management and revision control.

You would be joining an agile, innovative team working to provide applications and services which have high impact and visibility. We are committed to supporting our new team members including students and have built an environment that fosters knowledge sharing and consideration of others.


This is a great opportunity for an experienced developer to have a transformative impact on the student experience of digital learning and further their own career with a global leader in Higher Education.


Please contact Brian Green (brian.green@lancaster.ac.uk), Head of Innovation and Mobile Development, if you have any questions and would like to informally discuss the role.

jobs.title: Graduate Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready to launch your career?**

  

Join Amey and **start building a career with real impact.**

  

We are excited to offer a fantastic opportunity for a Civil Engineer Graduate to join our NMC NE team based in Perth. Whether you are finishing university or looking for the next step in your career, this is a great place to develop your skills, confidence and future career.

 **Starting Salary:** £30,000\.00 per annum (Subject to review)

**Location****:** Caledonian House, West Kinfauns, Perth. PH2 7XZ

**Working hours per week:** Monday to Friday, 9\.00 am to 5\.00 pm, 40 hours per week.

**Start date****:** July 2027

  

Our two\-year Graduate Pathway will challenge and inspire you to reach your full potential and build your career, with a guaranteed permanent position to transition into on completion. Throughout the programme, you will receive first\-class mentoring and structured learning and development to support your professional and personal growth. We will also contribute towards a relevant professional qualification.

 **About the team:**


Join our supportive and inclusive team within NMC NE, where you will work on projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK.


Amey is working in partnership with Transport Scotland Northeast since August 2022, with an increased focus on supporting the creation of sustainable futures for communities, together we will achieve net zero targets and improve the customer experience. Covering 593Km of network, we provide routine highways, bridges and structure maintenance as well as designing and managing road safety schemes. By ensuring our roads and highways are well\-maintained through all\-weather seasons and traffic incidents, we aim to create well\-functioning, safe spaces which minimise disruption, keep people moving and support thriving communities.

 **What you will do:**

* Plan and undertake specialist investigations.
* Assist with preparing technical documents and reports.
* Maintain high technical standards consistent with the project scope/brief.
* Provide design and specialist advice in relevant specialisms, e.g. pavements.
* Use of Transport Scotland’s Asset Management Performance System (AMPS) for scheme identification, development and recording of maintenance intervention.
* Assist the project manager with project related correspondence from internal and external stakeholders.
* Assist the project manager with Technical Workshops to discuss complex schemes and treatment proposals.
* Ensure compliance with relevant Health and Safety Legislation (CDM2015\).
* Ensure compliance at all times with the operating company's management system.
 **What you will bring:**


We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, keen to learn and ready to develop their career within a supportive and collaborative team.

* Minimum 2:2 degree in Civil Engineering.
* Full UK driving licence.
  

Behavioural competencies

* Passion for developing your skills, both professionally and personally.
* Enthusiasm for being part of a high\-performing team and a drive for success.
  

Please note that successful applicants will be required to undergo drug and alcohol testing, in line with our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant working environment.


Please upload your certificates, predicted grades or achieved qualifications with your application, as this information will be used during shortlisting. Any offer of employment is conditional upon meeting the required academic criteria. If you experience any issues uploading documents, please contact our People Services team.

 **Why join Amey?**


At Amey, we work on long\-term stable contracts so you can plan a long\-term career with us. We have been awarded Platinum status by Investors in People which underscores our commitment to supporting our people across every part of our organisation, enabling them to shine. Whether you are starting your career, returning to the workplace or can bring your professional expertise and skills, there is a place for you here.


Our benefits are designed to help you thrive at work and in your home life. You will have the flexibility to choose benefits and development opportunities that are best for you.

* **Salary and rewards:**Enjoy a competitive annual salary with the potential for yearly reviews to ensure you are rewarded for your contributions.
* **All\-round suppor**t: You will be supported throughout your graduate pathway by your manager, mentor, Early Careers team and wider graduate network.
* **Career Growth:** Throughout your graduate pathway, you will receive first\-class mentoring and a structured learning and development programme to enable your professional and personal development.
* **Training Opportunities:**Unlock your potential with comprehensive training, including fully funded leadership programmes tailored to your personal growth.
* **Career pathways:** Your graduate pathway can open the door to future opportunities across Amey, helping you build a long\-term career after your programme.
* **Holidays** \- Enjoy 24 days leave plus bank holidays and the opportunity to buy more
* **Pension** \- Generous pension scheme, with extra contributions from Amey
* **Flexible working** \- Work\-life balance and flexibility are key for our success. We empower our people to make choices that are right for them, with hybrid, part\-time and flexible work patterns open for discussion.
* **Flexible benefits** – Customise your benefits with options such as insurance benefits, Cycle2Work scheme and access to discounted gym membership.
* **Exclusive Discounts**\- Access our online portal filled with discounts from leading retailers, healthcare services, and more, helping you save on the things that matter.
* **Social Value** – you will get two Social Impact Days each year to volunteer for a charity of your choice and further opportunities to support fundraising initiatives and, where eligible, participate in the Duke of Edinburgh Gold Award.
* **Family friendly policies** for new parents or if you provide care for a dependant
* **Membership of our Affinity Networks**who connect, support and inspire diverse communities within Amey
 **About Amey**


Amey is a global, integrated infrastructure consultancy and operations partner. We design, deliver, protect, and maintain critical assets and systems.

  

  

We advise, design, finance, deliver, and enhance civic, transport, and defence systems. By combining strategic intelligence, engineering, infrastructure finance, and operational expertise, we create secure, resilient, compliant, and high\-value outcomes across the lifecycles of new and legacy assets.

  

What truly defines Amey is our commitment to people. Our business is only as strong as the individuals who power it, and our greatest asset is our team. If you're ready to learn, grow and start building a career with real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

To find out more take a look at our website Early careers \| Amey

 **Application Guidance and Diversity \& Inclusion**


At Amey we constantly evolve how we work to reflect the different needs and backgrounds of our employees. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age. We believe everyone deserves an opportunity to shine.

  

As a disability confident leader, we’re proud to guarantee applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role.

  

Please contact our recruitment team at peopleservices@amey.co.uk to discuss any access needs, reasonable adjustments or additional support that you may require at any point during the recruitment process.

  

Apply today. We are excited to hear from you!

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Growth Operations Engineer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of optimizing our technical infrastructure, ensuring seamless deployment, scaling, and maintenance of our growth\-focused platforms. Your expertise will drive efficiency, reliability, and scalability across our cloud and on\-premises environments, empowering us to accelerate user engagement and business expansion. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and possess a passion for cutting\-edge technology, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure using tools such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and OpenStack to support growth initiatives.
* Automate deployment pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, and Shell Scripting to streamline software releases and updates.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively using tools like New Relic, Splunk, Elasticsearch, and Nagios to ensure high availability.
* Collaborate with development teams on microservices architecture utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, Weblogic, JBoss, Tomcat, WebSphere, and REST APIs for efficient service delivery.
* Maintain configuration management and version control using SVN, GitHub, GitLab, TFS, or similar platforms to ensure consistency across environments.
* Conduct disaster recovery planning and implement strategies to safeguard data integrity and system resilience in cloud and on\-premises setups.
* Support software development lifecycle (SDLC), including system testing, debugging, release management, and continuous integration practices.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS (Amazon Web Services), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies including VMware and Virtualization concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying scalable applications.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash (Unix shell), Groovy or Perl for automation tasks.
* Familiarity with database systems including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database or T\-SQL for data management.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP protocols, firewalls, DNS, WAN/LAN configurations and TCP socket programming.
* Experience with DevOps practices such as continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), release management and system testing.
* Knowledge of software development frameworks like Ruby on Rails or.NET is a plus.
* Ability to gather requirements effectively through collaboration with cross\-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills combined with a proactive approach to incident management and system optimization.

Join us as a Growth Operations Engineer to help shape the future of our platform’s scalability and reliability! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where innovation thrives—empowering you to grow your skills while making a meaningful impact on our business growth journey.

Pay: £26,672\.47\-£66,428\.64 per year

Job Description
**Senior Software Engineer – (Full Stack)**


**Manchester/Hybrid**


Slalom is a global, human\-centric business and technology consulting firm. We specialise in partnering with organisations that aspire to excellence, helping them tackle complex challenges and achieve transformative results through strategy, technology and business transformation services. By prioritising people, Slalom creates a unique consulting experience, with a team of strategists and engineers delivering practical, end\-to\-end solutions that drive impactful outcomes for our clients. We empower people and organisations to dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows for all.


Our Software Engineering team builds the core applications and services that power our products and deliver value to users around the world. We focus on creating scalable, secure, and high\-performance systems that enable rapid innovation and seamless user experiences. By leveraging modern engineering practices and cloud\-native technologies, we aim to reduce complexity, accelerate delivery, and continuously improve our platforms.


We’re excited to welcome a Senior Software Engineer to join our Manchester team to help drive forward our mission of building world\-class software.


**Life as a Senior Engineer**


A Senior Engineer plays a fundamental role in shaping and delivering amazing software solutions to client challenges during discovery and delivery. You will partner with teams to understand the challenges they are facing as well as develop implementation and delivery plans that take advantage of emerging technologies at scale. During client delivery you will collaborate with Platform Engineers, Quality Engineers and AI Consultants to ensure that world class user experiences are understood, validation procedures are aligned and automation components are delivered.


Within our capability you'll be seeking to develop and grow your skills whilst advocating for progression of our capability on exciting frontiers such as Machine Learning and Generative AI.


**Specifically, you will:**


* Design, develop and maintain robust backend services and APIs using EITHER C\#/.NET, Python or Java, applying clean code principles, design patterns, and modern software engineering practices.
* Build modern, responsive and accessible frontend applications using EITHER React or TypeScript, focusing on exceptional user experiences and performance.
* Build quality, reliable and performant applications, with a strong focus on maintainability, security and scalability.

* Developed and maintained AI assisted development practices, utilising tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other coding assistants to accelerate software delivery while maintaining code quality standards.
* Implement containerisation using Docker and support scalable deployments using orchestration tools where appropriate.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient, automated and reliable software delivery.
* Foster a culture of inclusion and engineering excellence while promoting well\-being, diversity and collaboration across the organisation.

**What You'll Bring**


* Experience developing production applications using EITHER C\#/.NET, Python or Java.
* Commercial experience building modern web applications using EITHER React or TypeScript.
* Experience designing and developing scalable APIs, microservices and distributed systems.

* Integrated generative AI solutions into existing applications, leveraging APIs and prompt engineering techniques to deliver intelligent, context\-aware functionality.
* Hands\-on experience working with cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), including deployment and infrastructure concepts.
* An understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD, containerisation, observability and testing.
* A collaborative mindset, passionate about sharing knowledge and driving engineering best practices.

But what do we really mean when we talk about loving your life and your work? Let’s look at the ways in which we help our team members to achieve this – and the ‘how’.


**Deep connections, better outcome**


We have deep relationships with leading technology partners and they love us for our innovative and outcome based approach. Our people are passionate about solving our clients problems using the tech that’s the best solution for them. What’s more, we’re there to work side\-by\-side with our client teams to enable them for success long after we’ve gone. We’re all about momentum that outlasts us.
